description:
The Bug Factory’s carefully engineered mealworm growing pods allow users to stack additional mealworm trays for egg collection & odor-managing filters to create a steady supply of mealworms right at home without a strong smell. These pods offer a cost-effective alternative to purchasing mealworms every time your pets need a treat. Plus, since they are manufactured from 100% recycled fridge plastic, you’re not only turning food scraps into pet treats and plant fertilizer but also saving the planet.

Join us, and let's make every home a haven of comfort and efficiency.

As an affiliate in our Affiliate Program, you'll enjoy a suite of benefits designed to make your partnership with us both rewarding and enjoyable.

Commission Rate

Earn an attractive 10% commission on every order you bring in. The more you promote, the more you earn!

Promotion Method

Get a unique affiliate link and coupon upon signup to promote our brand. Any order made via your link or coupon will be credited to you.

Cookie Time

Enjoy a tracking time of 30 days to get commissions on any purchase they make within this period after clicking your link.

Commission Payouts

Get paid once reached to minimum payout threshold in average 60 payment days without any hassle via PayPal.

Welcome to Hatching Time & The Bug Factory ! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals/companies who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate” or “partner”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant. By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Partner Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your registration.

Who is Hatching Time?

Hatching Time offers the most hygienic and technologically advanced chick & game bird supplies on the market. From incubation to processing, Hatching Time offers everything you will need for your quail, chicken, partridge, turkey, duck, pheasant, geese or other birds. The Bug Factory joined to Hatching Time Family in 2024.

Hatching Time delivers the best in class poultry-keeping products for raising happy, healthy birds from start to finish. The equipment is designed for ease of use, cleanliness and automation.

Who is a Hatching Time partner?

  • We partner with individuals who are interested in promoting our products, offering a performance based reward when they refer to a new order.

  • The guidelines apply to all “Hatching Time Partners” and it defines any company or individual customers, affiliates, influencers, bloggers, referrals and business associates who are interacting with Hatching Time brand.

Why become a partner with Hatching Time?

  • Hatching Time is a fast-growing company in the poultry industry. We do not only offer you an experienced team that provides you advice and practical help, but also the high commissions and the low cancellation rate with various partnership models.

  • We offer up to 5% commission for all products and our programs have a 30 days cookie period. We also have a referral program and bonus system for all eligible affiliates.

  • Monthly Paypal payment option with minimum $150 threshold for our affiliate program on hatchingtime.com 

Who can join and what are the requirements?

  • Anyone passionate about poultry is welcome to join. Whether you're a blogger, influencer, at-home poultry enthusiast, homesteader, farm, breeder, hatchery or educator from the US, we're excited to partner with you.

  • The website must already be accessible and does not contain any wrongful content. 

  • Social media accounts at least 1K subscriptions or likes.

How can I join & earn money with the Hatching Time Affiliate Program?

You can join our in-house affiliate program on our website. We offer 5% commission sitewide for all products. However, coupon, cashback or deal websites get a 2% commission. If one of your viewers/visitors clicks our affiliate link, a cookie will be set. This cookie is valid for 30 days and attributes the customer to your account. Additionally, you’ll be assigned a dedicated coupon code, no matter the source of the clicked link, the commission will be granted if the user redeems your coupon at the checkout process. Please read our affliate program guide for more details

Affiliates must accumulate at least $150 in earnings before a payout is initiated. Commissions are paid out approximately 60 days following the end of the month in which they were earned. After receiving your first payout, you are eligible for monthly payouts, provided you meet the $150 threshold each month. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...)

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page. Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

Given that Hatching Time affiliate program provides the best terms of cooperation all you have to do is follow the rules carefully and provide high-quality traffic. The traffic you provide will be assessed according to the conversion rate and sales volumes as well as the number of new customers driven by your traffic source.

Additionally, you can join our Refer-a-Friend, Review and Write for Us programs to get a chance to win gift cards and discounts. 

Can I promote & earn money with other Hatching Time Affiliate Program?

Yes, Hatching Time is listed on Amazon, please review our Amazon store and popular products. You can promote our products via Amazon Associates - Amazon’s affiliate marketing program. Our product categories are eligible for a 3% - 5% commission rate for each Amazon sale. The policy regulations and terms & conditions, also tracking and payment are processed by Amazon.

If you have a Youtube channel and are eligible for Youtube Shopping Affiliate Program you can tag Hatching Time products in your videos. The actual commission rate is 5% for all listed products and 30 cookie days. You’ll get the commission with every sale once any of your viewers click the tagged products and make a purchase on our website. The payment is processed to your Adsense account, and the policy regulation and terms & conditions, also tracking are processed by Google.

Similar to the Youtube program, our products are also listed for TikTok Shop Affiliate Program. If your account is eligible you can find our product in the marketplace to tag your TikTok videos. The policy regulations and terms & conditions, also tracking and payment are processed by TikTok platform.

At last, please do not hesitate to reach out for any collaboration ideas, we are always happy to chat to work together.

Link & Coupon Usage 

  • It is prohibited to submit individual coupons to cashback & coupon & review & deal websites.

  • A partner must not use the coupons to mislead the users with the incorrect amount discounts or other benefits.

  • Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

  • Parner might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

  • Important note: If an affiliate code is entered at checkout, it will override any affiliate link. So for example, if someone visits your site, clicks the affiliate link, and then enters someone else’s affiliate code at checkout to get their discount, the code will take precedence and the other affiliate will receive the commission. If both code and link are yours, you’ll receive the commission once, as normal.

Domain Usage 

  • It is prohibited to use a Hatching Time trademark, including the Hatching Time or Cimuka name, in a domain name.

    • Example: hatchingtimesellerxyz.com etc. is not permitted

  • A partner must use their own company name in any domain that is used to sell or promote Hatching Time or its products.

  • It is prohibited to use an identical or virtually identical Hatching Time trademark in a domain name.

Social Media Usage

  • A partner must use their own company name and logo on their social handles.

  • Use of Hatching Time logos or icons on social media channels as the primary imagery is not permitted.

  • Use of our trademarked terms within social media handles, channel & profile names or titles of social pages is not permitted.

  • It is forbidden to create mobile applications, web pages and groups in social networks on behalf of Hatching Time as well as using Hatching Time logo.

  • No imagery within main images that could or might cause brand confusion are allowed to be used on social media profiles. Please do not use creative materials from our direct or indirect competitors on social networks.

  • No print or web copy may be copied from the Hatching Time website and other Hatching Time-owned properties, however it’s allowed to reshare our social media posts and please reach us for any asset requests.

Advertising Usage

  • Brand bidding is prohibited. Bidding on branded terms (Hatching Time, Cimuka, Comforplast, iPluck etc.) on paid media campaigns is prohibited. All bidding keywords should exclude brand keywords and any variations or misspellings. The point is, you can't use combinations or variations that might be considered as Hatching Time's official promotion for bidding.

  • Therefore, bidding on Hatching Time non-branded terms (egg incubator, quail cage, feather plucker, etc.) is permitted.

  • Don’t use redirected pages and links to send a user to our site. Direct PPC linking is not permitted.

  • Ads must not contain or mimic any Hatching Time ads or web copy without written permission from Hatching Time.

  • The use of a Hatching Time brand term may not be used within the vanity URL within display advertisements (ex:sellerxyz.com/hatchingtime)

  • Only the approved advertising material is permitted. All self-created display and banner ads pertaining to Hatching Time or its products must be approved by the Hatching Time Marketing Team.

  • Cookie spam, cookie-stuffing, forced clicks, click injection or any other unethical cookie & click fraud activities are strongly permitted.

  • Geo-targeting must be restricted ONLY to the US and CA target markets.

  • It is not allowed to use your affiliate link and coupons for your own purchases.

Violations & Enforcement

  • Hatching Time actively monitors how our branding is being represented by our Partners.

  • If a partner violates the Hatching Time Partnership and Branding, Hatching Time will be in direct contact with the partner and will walk them through the necessary steps to get back in compliance within a reasonable and established timeframe.

  • If a partner refuses to comply, all commissions for the last 30 days will be declined, the partnership will be terminated and legal action may be taken.

FAQ

I can’t log into my affiliate account. What should I do?

If you are unable to access your affiliate account or change the password, it is most likely a web browser configuration issue. To troubleshoot the issue, please try the following steps.

  • Log on with a PC or Mac. Phone browsers and tablets aren’t reliable for successful affiliate logins.

  • Ensure you are using the most recent version of your web browser.

  • Clean up your current web browser by clearing your cookies and cache.

  • Disable any third-party applications or add-ons for your browser that could affect cookies and scripts.

  • Close and restart the browser. Make sure cookies are enabled.

  • Your account might be disabled, make sure if you received a related email.

 

Where can I learn more about affiliate program?

You can review the UpPromote website to learn how to navigate on your account or learn the details of using the features. We also keep updating “Guide” and “Marketing Tools” sections to share helpful documents, banners or videos with you. Additionally, please make sure to subscribe to our newsletter as we constantly share updates about the promotions, product details and news about us. 

How much and how do I get paid? 

We offer a 5% standard commission for all eligible affiliates and 2% rate for selected accounts. You'll earn from the total cart value excluding the tax and shipping value. Payments are sent via PayPal once the total commission reached to min. $150 threshold and referrals are approved & remained in aging period. Please make sure to update your payment information.

After you sign up and get approved, you will have an active affiliate dashboard where you can access personalized links and coupons to use for promotion to earn. 

I have a pending commission on my affiliate account. When will I get paid?

All affiliate referrals go through appx. a 60-day aging period after the end of the month in which the sale occurred. All referrals still associated with active accounts after this period qualify for commissions which are paid out starting on the 1st of the month in which the aging period ends through the end of that same month. For example, commissions on referrals who purchased in January and have remained as valid transactions until March, they will be paid from April 1. Remember, payments are only issued if your payment field is successfully filled-out.

 

When do I know that the payment has been issued?

In your affiliate dashboard, click on Payment Information. Once your referral is approved its status will change to approved and once the payment has been processed, its status will change to paid. You can find the processed date and amount, as well as all other referral details. 

Why my coupon code doesn't work?

Please make sure there are no typos at the shared codes. Additionaly, there are minimum spending limitation for each code that can be found in your account. And the coupon codes are valid only for the new users who haven't made a purchase before, so we encourage you to drive traffic for new customers by using the affiliate links.
